# Distribution checklist

Package ID: `SRS-20000101-001-fixture-synthesis`
Title: Synthetic synthesis fixture
Created: 2000-01-01
Status: `Complete`
Distribution: `private`

The package remains private. No promotion is requested or recorded. It would
remain private unless a responsible human completes a structured promotion
record and the maintained validator accepts it. A
`public-candidate` package is not publication or release approval, and the
agent never grants or infers publication, release, or sign-off.

- [ ] Scope and the exact target commit are recorded.
- [ ] Private and restricted evidence is identified.
- [ ] Public queries contain no private identifiers.
- [ ] Redistribution status is recorded for every external source.
- [ ] Findings and claims do not exceed their evidence and the manifest.
- [ ] Every executed command has an approval record and retained evidence.
- [ ] Responsible-human promotion record is complete when promotion is requested.
